Property Summary
An excellent opportunity to acquire this beautifully presented three bedroom semi-detached home, ideally positioned in one of Wexford Town’s most sought- after residential areas. From the moment you step inside, the property offers an immediate sense of style, comfort and quality. The interior is thoughtfully finished throughout, with a modern neutral colour palette that creates a bright, elegant and welcoming atmosphere. The accommodation is both practical and well-proportioned, featuring a cosy living room and a superb kitchen/dining area. A versatile extension provides additional living space, offering excellent flexibility for a playroom, home offce or second lounge. All three bedrooms are beautifully presented, providing comfortable and inviting spaces ideal for family living. The timeless décor ensures the new owners can easily personalise the home while enjoying a property already in exceptional condition. To the rear, a sunny south-west facing garden offers a private, low-maintenance outdoor space perfect for relaxing, entertaining or enjoying the afternoon and evening sunshine. The home also benefits from a solar hot-water system, adding an energy-effcient touch to this impressive property. The location is a standout feature. Situated in the highly desirable Whiterock Drive area, the home is within easy reach of Wexford Town’s many amenities, including shops, cafés, restaurants, schools and the picturesque Quays. With its modern interior, tasteful décor, versatile layout and prime location, this is a wonderful home that will appeal to first-time buyers, families and anyone seeking a property that is truly ready to move into.

A beautiful home in an exceptional location!

EARLY VIEWING IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
